facts.fact: A DGID communique of 27 August 2026 says the SENTAX platform handles online tax declaration and payment for Large Enterprise Directorate (DGE) taxpayers, mandatory for all declarations and payments from 1 September 2026, with paper returns no longer accepted.
A DGID communique of 27 August 2026 says SENTAX now replaces the ETAX application for tax declaration and payment by DGE taxpayers.
